Bihar and Jharkhand Sign Agreement on Sone River Water Dispute

Bihar and Jharkhand have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to resolve a 25-year-old dispute over the sharing of Sone River water. The agreement was signed in the presence of Union Home Minister Amit Shah. This pact aims to end the long-standing conflict between the two states regarding water distribution from the river.
